official.deadline_note: Sierra Leone deadline: email all PDF materials plus Appendix 3 to sl@mofcom.gov.cn by 12 May 2026. The general program guide keeps the Economic and Commercial Counselor's Office open for application until 6 June 2026; university-specific portals may set their own earlier dates. Shortlisted applicants are notified in late May 2026 and admission results are announced around July-August 2026.
official.application_cycle: 2026 enrollment round (2026 MOFCOM Scholarship recruitment, notice issued 3 April 2026; 2026 Enrollment Guide)
official.status_note: The published 2026 round closed on 12 May 2026 with results expected July-August 2026; the embassy notice list shows the 3 April 2026 MOFCOM notice is still the latest, with no 2027 notice posted as of 2026-10-10.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Students are exempt from tuition fee, teaching material fee, research and survey fee, allowance of English-taught program, dissertation guidance fee.
benefits: Exemption from tuition fee, teaching material fee, research and survey fee, allowance of English-taught program and dissertation guidance fee
Monthly stipend of 36,000 RMB per year per master student and 42,000 RMB per year per PhD student, distributed by the universities on a monthly basis
One-off resettlement fee of 3,000 RMB per person
Free medical insurance for international students
One-time round-trip international airfare (first flight to China after enrollment and flight home at graduation) plus up to n-1 round-trip home-visit airfares, one per academic year
eligibility: Be a citizen of a developing country other than the People's Republic of China and under the age of 45 (born after 1 September 1981), in good physical and mental health with a physical examination report

Be public officials of division level and above in government sectors, or senior management staff of organizations and enterprises, or academic backbones of universities and research institutions - the Sierra Leone notice frames this as senior officials of the Sierra Leonean government, university faculty, or corporate executives
Have at least three years' working experience, and hold a bachelor's degree when applying for the master's program or a master's degree when applying for the doctoral program
Have English proficiency sufficient for the academic requirements of the program, equivalent to IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80 and above; HSK Level 3 or higher gives priority in the Sierra Leone round

Be neither studying in China nor admitted to other scholarship programs provided by the Chinese government - applicants who received any type of Chinese Government scholarship funding within the past three years are not eligible for this round
Sierra Leone notice additionally requires a minimum GPA of 3.25 on a 4-point scale or 4.0 on a 5-point scale
requirements: Register on the CSC Study in China portal (studyinchina.csc.edu.cn), select Program Category Type A and Agency Number 00010
Choose maximally three preferred universities out of the 26 designated universities and complete each university's own online application portal
Email the complete PDF document set plus Appendix 3 to sl@mofcom.gov.cn by 12 May 2026 with the subject line 'MOFCOM-CSC, GPA and Scale, Applicant Name, WhatsApp Number'
Keep the original hard copies, as documents are submitted only by email and online system; originals are presented for on-site verification at the interview
Attend the embassy interview if shortlisted in late May 2026; uninvited applicants are automatically disqualified
documents: Application form (university-specific or the MOFCOM-CSC form) as PDF
Two recommendation letters - one from the current employer (government department, institution or company) and one from an academic professor

Bachelor's or master's degree certificate and transcript with GPA score, stamped by the Ministry of Technical and Higher Education and authenticated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
Personal statement including a study plan or research plan of at least 1,000 words, plus resume/CV

Foreigner Physical Examination Form (Appendix 3) completed at the 34th Military Hospital or Jui Hospital with a Chinese physician's signature, plus police clearance / non-criminal record certificate (usually issued within 6 months of submission)
Passport copy valid for at least 18 months - official or diplomatic passports are not accepted - and the Applicant Information Form (Appendix 4)
selection_criteria: The Embassy submits a confidential shortlist to China based on academic and interview performance; no inquiries about the list are entertained
The final admission decision rests with the university's admission committee, and no explanation is given on the enrollment result
Incomplete or overdue applications are rejected
The annual review is compulsory for all students; only those who pass may continue to enjoy the full scholarship the next year

Monthly stipend of 36,000 RMB per year per master student and 42,000 RMB per year per PhD student

Free medical insurance for international students
One-time round-trip international airfare and up to n-1 round-trip international airfares for home visits (one time per year at the end of an academic year)

Direct email of the complete PDF document set and Appendix 3 to sl@mofcom.gov.cn by 12 May 2026

official.application_route: Register on the CSC portal under Type A / agency number 00010, complete each chosen university's own portal, then email the full PDF pack plus Appendix 3 to sl@mofcom.gov.cn by the embassy deadline and attend the interview if shortlisted.
official.study_mode: Full-time; scholarship recipients must register for English-taught programs, as the programs are fully conducted in English
official.citizenship_residency: Citizens of developing countries other than the People's Republic of China, aged 45 or under; this notice is issued by the Chinese Embassy in Sierra Leone for Sierra Leonean senior government officials, university faculty or corporate executives
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the program funds applicants from developing countries worldwide; this notice covers Sierra Leone
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Degree study at one of 26 designated universities (including Peking University, Tsinghua University, Renmin University, Fudan University, Zhejiang University and others) in applied fields of government, trade, foreign affairs, agriculture, technology, education, culture, health, energy and transportation, and public administration; applicants choose up to three preferred universities and CSC places each applicant in one university only
official.research_requirement: A study plan or research proposal is required; the Sierra Leone notice requires a personal statement including a study or research plan of at least 1,000 words
official.duration: 2 or 3 years for master's recipients and 3 or 4 years for PhD recipients, according to the enrolled length of schooling
official.description: Hosted by the Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China and administered together with the China Scholarship Council, the MOFCOM Scholarship-CSC Program fosters high-end business officials and managerial personnel for recipient countries by offering fully English-conducted master's and doctoral programs to governmental officials, research fellows and senior managerial personnel.
official.region: Africa (notice issued by the Chinese Embassy in Sierra Leone)
official.program_type: MOFCOM Scholarship-CSC Program (Ministry of Commerce of China scholarship administered with the China Scholarship Council); the wider MOFCOM Scholarship also runs a separate MOFCOM-40 direct-admission track
official.english_requirement: English proficiency sufficient for the academic requirements of the program, equivalent to IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80 and above (2026 Enrollment Guide); HSK Level 3 or higher gives priority in the Sierra Leone round

applicant_utility.summary: The MOFCOM Scholarship-CSC Program funds master's and doctoral degrees in China for senior government officials, university faculty and corporate executives from developing countries, covering tuition and fees, free on-campus accommodation, a monthly stipend (RMB 36,000 a year for master's, RMB 42,000 for PhD), a RMB 3,000 resettlement fee, medical insurance and round-trip airfare. Applications are channelled through the Chinese Embassy: candidates register on the CSC portal under Type A / agency number 00010, select up to three of 26 designated universities, and email the complete document set to the embassy by the national deadline. Admission is ultimately decided by the receiving university after an embassy interview and a confidential shortlist. Anyone who held Chinese Government Scholarship funding in the past three years is barred from the current round.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Mid-career public officials, university faculty and senior managers from developing countries - under this notice, Sierra Leoneans - who want a fully funded, English-taught master's or PhD in China.
application_readiness_checklist: Start the degree and transcript authentication chain early - the Ministry of Technical and Higher Education stamp plus Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation authentication takes days to weeks
Book the Foreigner Physical Examination Form early at the 34th Military Hospital or Jui Hospital, since the form needs a Chinese physician's signature
Draft the study or research plan to at least 1,000 words and brief two recommenders (current employer and academic professor) in advance
Obtain an ordinary passport valid for at least 18 months - official or diplomatic passports are refused
Complete CSC registration (Type A, agency number 00010) and each chosen university's portal before emailing the embassy pack by the deadline
common_rejection_risks: Missing the national deadline - incomplete or overdue applications are rejected outright
Degree certificates or transcripts lacking the ministry stamp and foreign ministry authentication
A physical examination done at the wrong hospital or without the Chinese physician's signature
Applying within three years of holding any Chinese Government Scholarship funding, or graduating from a Chinese university in 2026
Uninvited or no-show applicants at the embassy interview are automatically disqualified
Falsified documents - degrees have been revoked in previous rounds
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Applicants still fund document authentication and legalisation fees, police clearance and medical examination charges, translation or notarisation of documents not in Chinese or English, travel to the embassy interview, visa fees, and personal spending; the scholarship provides no funding for accompanying dependants.
document_audit: The passport must be an ordinary passport - official or diplomatic passports are not accepted - and valid at least 18 months
Both the degree certificate and the transcript separately need the Ministry of Technical and Higher Education stamp plus Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation authentication
The physical examination must use Appendix 3 at the 34th Military Hospital or Jui Hospital with a Chinese physician's signature; other hospitals do not count
The personal statement must contain a study or research plan of at least 1,000 words
Recommendation letters must be split one employer and one academic professor
The embassy email subject must follow the format 'MOFCOM-CSC, GPA and Scale, Applicant Name, WhatsApp Number'
alerts: The Sierra Leone deadline of 12 May 2026 is earlier than the general ECCO application window in the program guide (6 June 2026) - follow the national notice
Each applicant is placed in only one of the three chosen universities and no explanation is given on enrollment results
The annual review is compulsory; postponed graduation receives no continuing sponsorship
The embassy holds no in-person meetings during recruitment - only shortlisted candidates are contacted by email or phone
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register online on the CSC portal (Type A, agency number 00010) and at each chosen university's portal, email the full PDF pack plus Appendix 3 to sl@mofcom.gov.cn, attend the embassy interview if shortlisted in late May, and await placement and admission results in July-August.

official.deadline_note: The application must be filed in both the CSC Online Application System and the UCAS Online Admission System for International Students before the deadline. The UCAS financial aid page lists no 2027 call as of 2026-10-10. The registration date in the Admission Notice is the starting day of the scholarship.
official.application_cycle: 2026 cycle (Call for 2026 Chinese Government Scholarship for International Students to Study at UCAS)
official.status_note: The 2026 call closed on 31 January 2026 (Beijing Time); the UCAS financial aid page still lists the 2026 call as the latest Chinese Government Scholarship call as of 2026-10-10.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Successful PhD students who are awarded a scholarship are exempted from the tuition fee of RMB 40,000/year; successful Master students are exempted from the tuition fee of RMB 30,000/year; successful applicants are also exempted from the application fee of RMB 600.
benefits: Tuition fee exempted: RMB 40,000/year for PhD students and RMB 30,000/year for master's students

Monthly stipend of RMB 5,000 for PhD applicants and RMB 3,500 for master's applicants (of which RMB 1,500 for PhD and RMB 500 for master's is provided by the supervisor or the CAS Institute the applicant is enrolled in)
Free accommodation on the UCAS Beijing campus, or an accommodation subsidy of no more than RMB 700/month for master's students and no more than RMB 1,000/month for doctoral students living off campus
Medical insurance of RMB 800 per person
eligibility: Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid passport, friendly to China and abiding by the laws and decrees of China and UCAS rules and regulations
Be proficient in English or Mandarin

Master's applicants must hold a degree or diploma equivalent to a Chinese bachelor's degree and be no more than 35 years old; PhD applicants must hold a degree or diploma equivalent to a Chinese master's degree and be no more than 40 years old
Meet the general admission criteria for international students (2025 Enrollment Guide for international students)
Must not have accepted any other sponsorship at the time of application and cannot accept any other sponsorship during the period of this scholarship

Must study full time in the research institute of enrollment and not take any other job; applicants currently pursuing a master's or doctoral degree at any institution in China are not eligible for the corresponding program
requirements: Log in to the Online CSC Application System at https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login, fill in and submit the scholarship application - the agency number of UCAS is 80001 - and download the system-generated CSC Application Form

Log in to the Online Admission System for International Students at UCAS (https://is.ucas.ac.cn/#/login), choose 'Chinese Government Scholarship', and complete all required procedures before the deadline
Submit identical information in both systems
Complete and submit the Provisional Acceptance Form of International Student by UCAS Supervisor (Attachment 2) if a pre-admission letter is required
documents: Application materials listed in the Call for 2026 Master's and Doctoral Programs for International Students
CSC Application Form generated by the online CSC system
Provisional Acceptance Form of International Student by UCAS Supervisor (Attachment 2) where a pre-admission letter is required
Degree requirements documentation for applicants from countries with a different education system (Attachment 1)
selection_criteria: Provisional acceptance forms and pre-admission letters are not the final admission list
Successful applicants must attend annual reviews and take other examinations on time, otherwise the scholarship will be suspended or deprived

During the sponsorship period, successful applicants should publish research achievements with UCAS and the institutes they are enrolled in as their academic institutions, stating that the research is funded by the Chinese Government Scholarship
Applicants must not accept any other sponsorship during the scholarship period
coverage: Tuition fee exempted: RMB 40,000 per year for PhD students and RMB 30,000 per year for master's students
Monthly stipend: RMB 5,000 for PhD applicants and RMB 3,500 for master's applicants, partly provided by the supervisor or CAS Institute
Free accommodation on the UCAS Beijing campus or an off-campus accommodation subsidy (up to RMB 700/month for master's students, up to RMB 1,000/month for doctoral students)
Medical insurance of RMB 800 per person
application_method: Apply through the CSC online application system using UCAS agency number 80001
Apply in parallel through the UCAS Online Admission System for International Students and select the 'Chinese Government Scholarship' option
Submit identical information in both systems before the deadline
Register at the time and place indicated in the Admission Notice
official.application_route: File simultaneously in the CSC system (UCAS agency number 80001) and the UCAS international admission system, choosing 'Chinese Government Scholarship' and keeping the information identical in both.
official.citizenship_residency: Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport
official.international_eligibility: Yes - UCAS recruits outstanding young graduate students from all over the world
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Master's and doctoral programs at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences under the Chinese Government Scholarship - Chinese University Program (CSC agency number 80001); applicants must also meet UCAS general admission criteria for international students
official.research_requirement: During the sponsorship period, research achievements must be published with UCAS and the enrolled institutes as the academic institutions and must state that the research is funded by the Chinese Government Scholarship
official.duration: Master students: 36 months (with no extension). PhD students: 36 months with permitted extension of no more than 12 months.
official.description: Entrusted by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences recruits outstanding young graduate students from all over the world and provides them full scholarships for master's and doctoral study.
official.program_type: Chinese Government Scholarship - Chinese University Program (UCAS as host institution, CSC agency number 80001)
official.english_requirement: Applicants must be proficient in English or Mandarin; the call publishes no specific test score.

not_confirmed: Travel or airfare coverage - not published on the call page
2027 cycle deadline - no 2027 call published on the UCAS financial aid page as of 2026-10-10
Specific English or Mandarin test scores - proficiency is required but no score is published
verification.notes: All values checked directly on the UCAS Call for 2026 CGS page (value and benefits, eligibility, deadline, application process); the financial aid index confirms the 2026 call is the latest CGS call listed.

applicant_utility.summary: UCAS fully funds master's and PhD study through the Chinese Government Scholarship - Chinese University Program, waiving tuition (RMB 30,000-40,000 a year) and the RMB 600 application fee while paying a monthly stipend (RMB 5,000 for PhD, RMB 3,500 for master's) plus campus accommodation or an off-campus subsidy and RMB 800 medical insurance. The application runs as two parallel filings - the CSC portal and UCAS's own admission system - which must carry identical information and both land before the same deadline. Note that part of the stipend (RMB 1,500 for PhD, RMB 500 for master's) is paid by the supervisor's CAS institute, so confirm your supervisor's support early. Scholars must pass annual reviews and publish under UCAS affiliation with the funding acknowledged.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Research-minded international graduates aged 35 or under (master's) or 40 or under (PhD) seeking fully funded research training inside the Chinese Academy of Sciences system.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure a UCAS supervisor's provisional acceptance (Attachment 2) early if a pre-admission letter is required - it is not admission itself but unlocks that step
Build the CSC application first, then mirror the degree, major and supervisor details word-for-word in the UCAS system
Check Attachment 1 for the degree-equivalence rules applicable to your country's education system before filing
Plan around a late-January Beijing Time deadline: the 2026 call closed on 31 January, and the 2027 call was not yet published as of 2026-10-10
common_rejection_risks: Mismatched information between the CSC and UCAS systems
Applying while already enrolled in a master's or doctoral programme in China - automatic disqualification at that level and report to the current institution
Holding or accepting any other scholarship - barred both at application and during sponsorship
Treating the two systems as sequential rather than parallel and missing the single common deadline
Mistaking a provisional acceptance form or pre-admission letter for final admission and losing contact with the supervisor or institute
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The call publishes no airfare or travel support, so international flights, visa fees, and spending beyond campus accommodation or the published off-campus subsidy (RMB 700-1,000 per month) must be self-funded.
document_audit: Degree and translation documents must satisfy the Attachment 1 equivalence rules for your country's education system
The CSC Application Form must be the system-generated form, not a self-made substitute
Attachment 2 must be signed by the assigned UCAS supervisor, not a professor elsewhere
alerts: An application counts only when filed in both systems - CSC (agency number 80001) and UCAS
The scholarship is suspended or revoked if annual reviews or examinations are missed
Publications during the sponsorship must name UCAS and the enrolled institutes as affiliations and acknowledge Chinese Government Scholarship funding - agree this with your supervisor at the start
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: File first in the CSC system under UCAS agency number 80001, then in the UCAS admission system choosing 'Chinese Government Scholarship', keep both in sync before the late-January deadline, and register at the time and place in the Admission Notice.
